joining_perks: When you shop and dine with the Axis Bank Neo Credit Card, when you apply for the Axis Bank Neo Credit Card, you will have to pay a joining fee of Rs.250. The joining fee is waived off for you if you spend a minimum of Rs.2,500 within 45 days of card approval. From the second year onwards, the annual fee is Rs.250. The interest is charged for any outstanding amount of Rs.250.
reward_structure:
Earn 2 reward points for every Rs.200 spent using the Axis Bank Neo Credit card under the EDGE Loyalty Program.
The reward points can be redeemed from an exclusive catalogue on the Axis Bank website.
key_highlights:
- The card offers a wide range of offers, benefits, and privileges. With this credit card, you get benefits such as Welcome offers from Amazon, cashback offers, gift vouchers, and entertainment offers.
- EMI facility is offered which includes an option on selected products.
- Lost card liability insurance is given.
- The card offers a range of lifestyle benefits across various categories such as dining, movies, and shopping.

benefits_features.Lifestyle benefits on the Axis Bank Neo: Avail attractive dining offers at various restaurants in India under the Axis Bank Dining privileges program.
benefits_features.Travel Offers:
- Opt for easy EMI payments for your travel bookings made on Yatra and Goibibo.
- Avail a discount of up to Rs.6,000 on your domestic and international flight bookings made on EaseMyTrip.
benefits_features.Movie Offers: - Movie ticket booking on BookMyShow gives you a discount of 20%, with monthly benefits up to Rs.50.
benefits_features.Shopping Offers:
- Shopping on Myntra assures you a 20% discount on a minimum purchase of Rs.2,500.
- Get a discount of 20% on purchases above Rs.1,000 made on BigBasket.
- Avail EMI offers on a range of products made from brands like Croma, Reliance Digital and Shopclues.
- Enjoy up to a 100% cashback on mobile recharges/connections made on the PhonePe app or website.
- On Myntra.com, get a 10% discount on purchases amounting to a minimum of Rs.50.
benefits_features.EMI facility:
- Convert your high-value purchases into equated monthly installments.
- Tenures range from 6 months to 24 months.
- Any purchase amounting to Rs.2,500 can be converted into monthly installments.
benefits_features.Dining Privileges: - You can enjoy up to Rs.150 off on dining at various restaurants located across India.
benefits_features.Secure Transactions: - The credit card comes with an embedded EMV chip, to make your online transactions more secure.
benefits_features.Lost Card Liability:
- Axis Bank also allows lost card liability insurance to Neo credit cardholders.
- First, you must report it to the customer service and all transactions on the card will be protection after that.

how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points Earned on Ax:
The points you earn from your credit card has a validity of 3 years which will automatically expire. It is advised to keep a regular check on the reward points earned in order to redeem it.
Here are the steps to follow to redeem your reward points:
- Login to your net banking.
- Select Account Summary.
- Click on the EDGE Rewards option.
- Check the terms to accept the term and conditions and then click on Redeem Now to redeem your reward points.
- From the drop-down menu, choose the category/reward and add them.
- Once done, click on confirm and the points will be redeemed.

miscellaneous: The limit for the Axis Neo Credit Card is given at the discretion of the bank. The credit limit offered to the cardholder is based on a number of factors which include the credit history, credit score, your net worth along with your past and ongoing debts.

faqs.What are the different modes of paying m: The online payment methods include NEFT transactions, net banking, mobile banking, Bill Desk, Visa, cash, and Axis ATMs.
faqs.What are the entire charges associated w: The list of all the charges associated with the Neo Credit Card has been mentioned under the fees and charges section. You can refer to the table above for more information.
faqs.Does Axis Bank offer any free period for: Yes, the interest is waived off if card is repaid by May 20, 2019 based on your transaction date.
faqs.How do I report the loss or my Axis Bank: Contact the credit card customer care by dialing 18604195555, 18604195555 to report the loss of the card.
faqs.Can I get duplicate monthly statements f: Yes, duplicate monthly statements can be issued by Axis Bank; you only need to make a request for the same to the bank, provide the outstanding monthly dues are paid.
faqs.How many days it would take to get my cr: The bank may take up to two to three weeks to send this credit card to your communication address.
faqs.I am a non-resident Indian (NRI). Can I: If you are a non-resident Indian then you can surely apply for this credit card and providing all the correct documents. KYC documents for the application for the credit card to be successful.
faqs.How can I apply for the new Axis Bank Ne: You can check the status of your Neo Credit Card; check it by calling the customer care number and quoting your application or reference number or by simply logging into your net banking portal where you will find an option to see the status of your credit card application.
faqs.How can I view my e-Statement?: You can view your statement by simply logging in to the net banking portal where you will find the Credit Card section. Simply select the Neo Credit Card from which you want to check the statement. Click on 'View Statement' and select the period for which you want to check the list of transactions.
faqs.How can I authorize online?: You can also authorize the bank to send you a statement at the end of the month to your registered email ID provided.
faqs.I am below the age of 18 years and I wan: If you are below the age of 18 years you cannot apply for Neo Credit Card. Your parents will then have to apply on your behalf. Their consent will be given; the credit card will be issued in your name; and your parents will have to submit the necessary KYC documents for the application for Neo Credit Card to go through.
